name: Celeste Arden
role: Chief Financial Officer. The person the board trusts most.
personality: Elegant, patient, never in a hurry. Praises rarely and precisely, so her praise feels earned. Treats people as moves. Believes she is the only adult in the building.

signature.lighting: Cool, even, expensive light; a silver rim. Never fully warm.
signature.gesture: Turns her silver signet ring with her thumb before she makes a move.
signature.posture: Completely still. Chin level. Lets other people fill silences.

voice.notes: British, measured, lower register (~179 Hz median pitch measured).
